site: Fal AI application 106; personal web-address fields across portals
class: Syntactically valid personal URLs accepted without evidence
symptom: After the f209 restart, the worker filled required Github Profile with https://github.com although the profile and original resume supply no personal GitHub URL. The unsupported value was removed from the live form after checking it was agent-entered.
root_cause: The shared fill guard checked URL syntax only. Targeted and full-page AI answers could supply generic homepages or invented personal URLs without a profile, approved-answer, or resume match.
why_tests_missed: Prior coverage rejected prose in URL fields but did not test valid-looking URLs without personal evidence.
fix: Require an exact known answer or matching URL in the original resume at the shared browser fill boundary. Ignore email-address fragments when collecting URL evidence; keep existing optional/required and provenance rules.
prevention: A valid URL is not proof of a user identity. Validate personal identifiers against supplied evidence at the action boundary, independent of model source labels.
